vernacular_zh: 龙已出现在田野上，开始崭露头角，适合拜见德高望重的人。
translation_en: The dragon appearing in the field. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.

scripture.text_zh: 所以，你们要自卑，服在神大能的手下，到了时候，他必叫你们升高。
scripture.text_en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time.

note_zh: 乾卦中的龙是阳刚、君子、圣王的象征。
note_en: In Qian, the dragon symbolizes yang strength, the noble person and the sage-king.
insight_zh: 易经：龙现于田，**时至而显**；彼得：谦卑顺服，**按时升高**。
insight_en: I Ching: the dragon appears **when its time comes**. Peter: stay humble, **God lifts in due time**.
